status: development protocol; no model experiment preregistered or completed
primary_question: Does selecting observations improve successful action under equal available sensors and a common resource cap?
split_warning: These are public, authored configuration groups. Fresh seeds are not an independently held-out mechanism or a secret test set.
controlled_factors: geometry intervention under fixed nuisance variables
camera orientation, translation and affine calibration
costly observation versus robust terminal action
friction/contact state and simulated irreversible outcomes

policy_conditions.adaptive: Select subsequent sensing using currently available observations.
policy_conditions.fixed_sensing: Commit to a sensor sequence before receiving episode observations; terminal action may use all those observations.
policy_conditions.query_free: Use the public task contract and operational feedback without buying perception.
policy_conditions.robust: Choose a legal conservative alternative without requiring complete hidden-state recovery.
policy_conditions.privileged_diagnostic: Evaluator-state diagnostic only, never a model score.

resource_contract.physical_time_accounting: Report simulated time separately from tool costs and wall-clock inference.
resource_contract.observation_bandwidth: Report delivered PNG bytes, RGB dimensions, query counts and serialized response bytes.
resource_contract.repeat_noise: Fixed-pattern images repeat exactly; no independent noise-reduction credit from repeated capture.
resource_contract.inference_budget: Must be frozen and reported for each external model study.

required_metrics: both members of a complete intervention pair succeed
component recovery and downstream outcome separately
simulated collisions, slips, damage and deadline failures
failure_controls: replace observations with a scene-independent blank image
swap images across paired causal interventions
remove or corrupt a calibration landmark
suppress the useful view while retaining irrelevant observations
try legal robust alternatives and unsafe probes
test invalid actions for state atomicity
compare complete public payloads under observation-equivalent worlds
external_model_release_gates: Freeze source, task mechanism roster and inference budgets before model access.
Keep evaluator source, private state, labels and traces out of the solver's OS environment.
Run at least one independently authored future mechanism group.
Use source-bound verifier versions, preserving all discovered failures separately.
Obtain external replication before broad scientific or robotics-transfer claims.
